Full-Stack AI Product Engineer
Remote (US timezones)

About us:
We are a small team shipping an AI product for creative professionals.

What you'll do:
- Build full-stack features in TypeScript and React.
- Design REST API and Server-Sent Events endpoints in FastAPI.
- Integrate LLM application pipelines with the Anthropic Claude API.
- Compose multi-agent workflows with deterministic validation gates.

Requirements:
- Strong TypeScript and Python.
- Experience shipping LLM pipeline features to production.
- Comfort with Docker and serverless deployment.

Nice to have:
- Prompt engineering experience.
- Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG).
